CORRECTED (leak fix). Input columns = ['text'] only -- exactly the {{placeholders}} in this task's original base_prompt.txt, i.e. exactly what the LLM saw when the published score was produced. The dataset also ships parties_are_diverse and aic_is_met, which are the paper's gold annotations of the two intermediate reasoning steps, NOT prompt inputs. An earlier version of this registry kept them (wrongly reasoning they were 'compositional inputs by design'); with them present a logistic regression learns answer = diverse AND aic and scores ~100%, which is a leak, not a result. Rule now enforced by tests/test_input_columns_match_prompt.py against data/prompt_placeholders.json.
